committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 18 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend jumped from $83.95 to $171.23 over the last 7 days and clicks went 14 to 27, but conversions are still zero and CPC sits at $6.34. Post restart clicks since 8 Sept are at 38 of the 150 stop loss threshold, so the economics need watching, not panicking.

Budget lost share (19%) is still well under rank lost share (75.1%), so the budget conversation has not opened yet. CTR slipped from 5.4% to 3.3% even as impressions nearly tripled (258 to 815), worth a look at the new geo-agency exact keywords.

The homepage (32 sessions) and /ai-automation-agency.html (22 sessions) are carrying almost all the traffic, yet calculator use stayed at zero both this week and last despite sessions up 81%. The tool sits between landing page and booking and nobody is touching it.

AI Assistant sessions moved from 0 to 2, both from chatgpt.com, first sign of life on answer engine visibility, though this channel undercounts since many AI referrals land in Direct with no referrer. LinkedIn is still flat at zero, so if Chris has kept posting there those links are probably going out untagged.

actions.text: Add the logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the ad groups currently serving under the restructure.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree confirm rather than before it, so lead counts reflect confirmed submissions only.
Update RSA description D1, which still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, to match the current site stats.

weekly: 56 this week versus 31 prior (up 81%), with yesterday (Thu 17) at 11 sessions against 6 on the same weekday last week.
every generate_lead event to date has been Chris testing his own form, so genuine enquiries are still unverified and unconfirmed by Google Ads conversions.
Paid Search and Direct both grew,
Paid Search moved 12 to 17 sessions and Direct 12 to 21, but Direct still predates full internal traffic filtering in places and should not be read as organic demand.
AI Assistant traffic appeared for the first time,
2 sessions from chatgpt.com against zero prior, though this metric undercounts since many AI referrals land in Direct with no referrer; LinkedIn stayed at zero despite ongoing posting.
Search Console shows tiny but real visibility,
249 impressions and 7 clicks over the 8 days through 15 September (two day reporting lag), led by /simpro-xero-integration.html with 118 impressions but no clicks yet at position 20.
